column3: The Hebrew explicitly repeats soul for Your servant; BSB says bring joy to Your servant.
The Hebrew explicitly names the voice of supplications in the plural; BSB has plea for mercy.
The Hebrew commands uniting my heart; BSB says give me an undivided heart.
The Hebrew explicitly names my soul; BSB says me.
The Hebrew names my soul and pictures not regarding You as not setting You before them; BSB says my life and no regard.
The Hebrew asks for a sign for good; BSB calls it a sign of Your goodness.
